item.title: Four African leaders issue joint declaration as Ethiopia war escalates
item.description: Egyptian, Eritrean, Somali and Sudanese leaders also call for talks to end the civil war in Sudan.

item.title: Iran war live: Yemen fighting intensifies; Tehran says ready for US attacks
item.description: Yemeni government announces major offensive against Houthis, as Iran says it is ready to defend itself if US attacks.

item.title: Israel face spitting allegation as Ireland boss ‘delighted’ ties after over
item.description: Ireland manager says 'disciplinary committee will look at' allegations Israel player spat at one of his coaching staff.

item.title: Manchester City must be relegated, says Canada’s ex-Leeds manager
item.description: Jesse Marsch alleges Man City's financial wrongdoing was widely known in the Premier League, and relegation must follow.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo can return to Portugal team if he wants, says Jesus
item.description: Ex-Manchester United and Real Madrid star Cristiano Ronaldo left Portugal squad on Wednesday, but door open for return.

item.title: Mysterious luminous object burns in the skies above Libya
item.description: A mysterious object has been filmed flying over Tripoli and western Libya, followed by reports of a loud explosion.

item.title: Man’s miraculous catch saves child after balcony fall in Egypt
item.description: Dramatic video shows a man in Egypt rushing and catching a child who fell from the second floor.

item.title: Nicaragua says it will withdraw from Central American Parliament
item.description: The country's crackdown on human rights has left it increasingly isolated in Latin America.

item.title: US withdraws B-1 bomber aircraft from UK’s Fairford base amid Iran fears
item.description: The abrupt redeployment to the US comes after several 'terrorism-related' arrests were made outside RAF Fairford.

item.title: Cornell case puts New York’s progressive image at odds with its rape laws
item.description: New York lawmakers will review sexual-assault laws, including voluntary intoxication rule at the heart of Cornell case.

item.title: Ireland refuse handshake with Israel and don armbands in Nations League tie
item.description: Republic of Ireland football players again wear black armbands and refuse handshakes with Israel in UEFA Nations League.

item.title: Ronaldo-less Portugal beat Norway 2-1 to reach Nations League quarterfinals
item.description: Holders Portugal first team to qualify for 2026-27 UEFA Nations League despite Cristiano Ronaldo's absence.

item.title: Israel lashes out as UK’s Green Party formally defines Zionism as ‘racism’
item.description: Israel's president declared that the 'antisemitic lie' deliberately endangers Jews and Israelis.

item.title: Debris found near Nantucket believed to be from missing medical plane
item.description: The US Coast Guard says a field of debris found near Nantucket is believed to be from an emergency medical plane.

item.title: Brazil election results live: Lula and Bolsonaro locked in a tight race
item.description: Leftist incumbent Lula is seeking a fourth term in office, facing off against right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Imran Khan’s party launches march to Islamabad demanding his release
item.description: Supporters of jailed former Pakistani prime minister Imran Khan have launched a long march towards Islamabad.

item.title: Will elections bring change to multi-ethnic Bosnia and Herzegovina?
item.description: Balkan nation seeks EU membership, but divisions threaten that goal.

item.title: France to shutter up to 500 schools as more student protests called
item.description: Education minister cites safety concerns for closures as organisers call for resumption of protests.

item.title: Pro-Imran Khan mass rally launched after Pakistan government talks fail
item.description: Supporters of jailed former prime minister have set off from northwest Pakistan towards Islamabad.

item.title: War on Iran: Is escalation more likely than a deal?
item.description: Former Iranian and US diplomats agree that the war on Iran is likely to get worse in the coming weeks.

item.title: Ku Klux Klan leader claims rising support ahead of US midterm elections
item.description: The Ku Klux Klan says support for its message is growing as it seeks to rebrand around family and faith.

item.title: Police investigating Flydubai co-pilot’s Australia ties
item.description: Australian police and intelligence join the list of those probing the incident.

item.title: Ukraine ready for US-backed talks with Russia: Zelenskyy
item.description: Trilateral talks could happen this month in UAE or another US-proposed venue, says the president.

item.title: Mass protests demanding poll chief resignation shake India for third day
item.description: Protesters say the election commission’s voter-roll revision has removed millions of eligible voters to benefit PM Modi.

item.title: Germany’s Merz in Kyiv announces $1.5B in aid, urges Putin to end war
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, on a surprise visit to Kyiv, announced $1.5 billion in military and reconstruction aid
